_comment: Scoped to four INVARIANT modules rather than the whole server: mutation
testing costs one test run per mutant, and the question worth that price
is not 'is every line covered' but 'would a wrong answer in the money,
numbering and CSRF rules be noticed'. The four are pure, already carry
dedicated unit suites, and each encodes a rule AGENTS.md calls
src/mb-compute.ts     Measurement Book quantities and money.
src/executed-value.ts the GST-basis comparison a Work's completion
predicate rests on; a surviving mutant here
closes a Work with a sixth of it unbilled.
src/number-series.ts  document number templates — numbering is
gap-free and a cancelled number is never reused.
The break threshold is a FLOOR, not a measurement: no baseline score
existed when this landed. Raise it to just under the first weekly run's
reported score, and keep raising it.
